rationale: Substantive new technical machinery (the auditor's disaggregation and trigger methodology) and a genuinely novel reframing (State/Family Holding/Investors arguing board arithmetic, not contract language, is the real safeguard, with Investors proposing a fixed-date board vote as the process terminus) emerged this round, but the core dispute over what a verified shortfall authorizes remains unresolved and the Works Council/Union have not yet responded to this reframing, so further rounds are likely to produce movement rather than mere repetition.
